subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'become.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***He did ___(4)___ a great artist...***'' is telling **something related to** a great artist.
 
• The **verb that follows 'did'** should be used **in its base form**.
 
• The **auxiliary verb 'did'** is marked **for past tense**, but the **main verb** is not and it appears **in its base form**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'become', the base form of the verb.
 
• The word 'become' means **to begin to be something**. 
 
 
• Example:* All these infants did **become** healthy children with intact self-identity*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete Sentence: *He did **become** a great artist...*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us explore the other options:

__
 
• 'Became' is the past tense form of the verb. ('Became' क्रिया का past tense रूप है)
 
• 'Becomes' is the third-person present singular form of the verb. ('Becomes' क्रिया का third-person present singular रूप है)
 
• 'Becoming' is the gerund or present participle form of the verb. ('Becoming' क्रिया का gerund or present participle रूप है)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*He did ___(4)___ a great artist...*'' एक महान कलाकार से संबंधित कुछ बता रहा है।
 
• '**Did**' **के बाद आने वाली क्रिया** को उसके **मूल रूप में** प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
 
• Auxiliary verb '**did**' **भूतकाल **के लिए चिह्नित है, लेकिन **मुख्य क्रिया** नहीं है और यह **अपने मूल रूप में** प्रकट होती है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'become' है, जो क्रिया का मूल रूप है।
 
• शब्द 'become' का अर्थ है **कुछ हो जाना, कुछ बन जाना**। 
 
 
• उदाहरण: *All these infants did become healthy children with intact self-identity*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है ।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *He did become a great artist...*
